notes: Origin is behind Akamai and returns 403 Access Denied to direct HTTP (and translate.goog is refused with 400/403); all pages were read through the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which returns the origin's rendered listing pages. Every qty is the listing header's own 'N items' string. Cross-checked against the 'Page 1 of M' indicator: all 38 counts are consistent with 30 products per page (M-1 pages < qty <= M pages), and counts vary per category, so no site-wide total was picked up. Category tree is two levels (mega menu / SiteMapView); the only on-page refinements are colour/style/material/price filters, which were not treated as sub-categories. Excluded per brief: furniture, rugs, door mats, bedding, pillows/throws, storage, outdoor furniture and covers, umbrellas, fire pits, mailboxes; also Shop All / View All / New Arrivals / Under-$100 / Clearance nav pages. Dropped '/indoor-decor/baskets/' (2 items, storage baskets) and '/outdoor-living/entertaining/' (4 items: a lawn game, a pitcher and two bar carts) as out of scope. '/area-rugs-door-mats/indoor-lighting/' (73 items) is the same catalogue category as '/indoor-decor/indoor-lighting/' (73 items) and '/area-rugs-door-mats/outdoor-lighting/' (24) duplicates '/outdoor-living/outdoor-lighting/' (25); only one row kept for each. '/gifts-celebrations/halloween-decorations/' (296 items) is titled 'Shop All Halloween Decor' and was skipped in favour of its 12 Halloween Haven leaves.
